text: Naukot Fort Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Naukot Fort Type: Monument - Fort Province: Sindh District: Tharparkar Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 18th-19th Century CE Description: This fort is said to have been built by Mir Karam Ali Khan Talpur in 1814 CE. It is roughly square in plan measuring 195 x 183 m. The fortification wall is built of baked bricks laid in mud mortar. On the southern side exists an arched gateway flanked by semi-circular bastions. It was used by the Talpur Mirs as a stronghold cum residence.
